_comment: Every text of the Slack message. Override single keys with the `texts` input field; keys starting with an underscore are ignored. An unknown key fails the run, so a typo cannot pass unnoticed.
_footer: Slack italics do not survive a newline, so each footer line carries its own underscores. Set footer to "" to print no legend at all.
newPrHeader: New PRs — nobody has looked at these yet:
blockedPrHeader: Blocked PRs — make sure they are not forgotten:
footer:
_The tagged person is the PR author — chase your reviewers, or pull in someone new._
_Really blocked? Put the `blocked` label on the PR and comment why — the bot then leaves it alone._
